_arm_c_design_notes.comparison_role: Arm C of JAZZ 2026-09-21 3-arm question. Same panel + universe as A-17 arm B; differs only in the factor-AND-gate at leg construction (step ⑦ of decide_panel_long_only).
_arm_c_design_notes.min_history_days_90_rationale: A-17 v1 uses 60d (SMA60 needs 60 bars; mom_60 needs 61). For the simple-factor arm we add 30d buffer (vol_window=30 needs ~31 bars of returns) → 90d minimum. Each symbol must have at least 90d history past as_of - 1 before it can be ENTERED-eligible.
_arm_c_design_notes.factor_thresholds_rationale: vol_threshold_daily_stdev=0.05 = 5% daily stdev ≈ ~95% annualized. Above this, the symbol is filtered as 'too volatile for the simple trend-following baseline'. Tweakable via spec.parameters.factor_filter; v1 uses a conservative cutoff.
_arm_c_design_notes.skip_when_0_pass: If 0/N symbols pass the factor gate, return SKIPPED with reason '0/N passed factor gate (sma=N, mom=N, vol=N)'. This is the arm's expected behaviour during RISK_OFF windows — DO NOT interpret as a bug.
_arm_c_design_notes.equal_weight_over_passing_subset: If 3/5 pass, weight = 1/3 per passing symbol (not 1/5 with the other 2 as cash). This is the cleanest comparison vs arm B (which is 1/5 always). Difference between arm B and arm C is then 'factor gate value added'.
_arm_c_design_notes.no_jev_gate: Arm C deliberately runs WITHOUT Jev — it's a pure factor model. Jev vs factor is the third dimension of the 3-arm comparison (JAZZ 2026-09-21). Pattern A Jev gate is wired into arms A and B but not C.

validation_summary.expected_paper_behavior: Lower frequency than arm B (factor gate skips some symbols). Expected Sharpe and MaxDD vs arm B is the comparison point.
validation_summary.expected_diff_vs_arm_b: Lower n_periods (fewer ENTERED days due to factor skip). SR difference IS the signal — if arm C SR ≈ arm B SR, the factor gate adds no value. If arm C SR >> arm B SR with comparable MaxDD, gate is worth promoting.
validation_summary.lag_discipline: lag-1 PIT: factor signals use bars ≤ d-1, entry price = bar at d (mirrors A-17 spec_runner.py:986-989)
